latestVersion.changelog:
- Initial release of construction-quote skill.
- Generates detailed, itemised construction quotes, material lists, and job costings from plain English descriptions.
- Covers extensions, kitchens, bathrooms, loft conversions, roofing, garage conversions, plastering, electrical rewires, and general UK building work.
- Uses current UK material prices and labour rates; explains regional cost variations.
- Gathers essential job details with clear questions if information is missing.
- Includes a disclaimer on estimate accuracy and the need for site visits and supplier quotes.
